summary.text: Failed webhook deliveries now retry with a wait that doubles each time. The delivery path hands retryable errors to the new policy instead of returning them.

verdict.text: Check the retry budget before merging.

points.text: Nothing caps the number of attempts, so a remote that stays down is retried forever.

summary.risk_why: Every failed delivery now takes the retry path. A remote that stays down is retried without a cap.

intent.asked: Retry failed deliveries with a doubling wait
intent.got: Failed deliveries retry with a doubling wait; nothing stops them yet

area.text: The delivery package sends webhook payloads to the URLs customers register.

reached_by.text: The worker calls the client's deliver function for every queued event.

contracts.text: A delivery that returns an error is reported to the customer at once.

sections.title: Retry policy
sections.gist: A new policy says how long to wait before each retry.

level_reasons.text: Every failed delivery now waits on this policy.

sections.summary: A policy holds the number of attempts and the first wait. The wait doubles with every attempt.

steps.title: Policy holds the budget
steps.text: The policy keeps how many attempts to make and the first wait.

steps.title: Wait doubles
steps.text: Each attempt waits twice as long as the one before.

risks.text: Nothing reads the number of attempts, so a remote that stays down is retried forever.

sections.title: Delivery error path
sections.gist: Retryable errors go to the policy instead of the customer.

level_reasons.text: Only errors marked retryable change their path.

sections.summary: A retryable error now schedules a retry. Any other error is returned as before.

steps.title: Retryable errors wait
steps.text: A retryable error schedules the delivery again under the policy.

steps.title: Other errors return
steps.text: Any other error is returned to the caller at once.

sections.title: Dependency update
sections.gist: A dependency moves to its next minor version.
sections.summary: The lock file records the new version of one dependency.
